summary: P3, I16 and the owner rule (verdict-only tests). test_rejects_an_upload_before_the_verification ends with `self.assertIn(upload, publish)`. That asserts the shipped publish.yml contains the literal step name `- name: Upload man pages`, which is a check on workflow source text with no verdict behind it: renaming the step turns the test red while the checker's verdict is unchanged. `mutate` already fails when its anchor is missing. Fix: delete that line and the unused `upload` variable. Blast radius: test only.
